units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 17:18">Tosef. Sabb. XVII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 18:18">XVIII</cite>), 18; <cite ref="Shabbat 151b:3">Sabb. 151ᵇ</cite> <he>כלי מ׳</he> cooling vessels (glass &c.).
Ib. 53ᵇ אין מ׳ לבהמה cooling (as placing in water) is not generally done to beasts (unless they are sick).—[Part. Hif. מיקר, v. קָרַר.]
